paragraphs.text: Our school sports day comes every October. Everyone in my class feels excited about it. Our teacher says that we should try our best.
paragraphs.translation: 我们学校的运动会每年十月举行。班上每个人都很期待。老师说我们应该尽自己最大的努力。

paragraphs.text: I usually run fast, so my class chose me. I felt happy but also a little nervous. I thought that I could not run well.
paragraphs.translation: 我平时跑得挺快，所以班里选了我。我既高兴又有点紧张。我觉得自己肯定跑不好。

paragraphs.text: Every afternoon we practiced on the playground. My friend Li Ming always cheered for me. He said that I ran the fastest.
paragraphs.translation: 每天下午我们都在操场上练习。我的朋友李明总是为我加油。他说我跑得最快。

paragraphs.text: On sports day, the playground was full of students. My heart beat fast before the race. Our team stood in a line and waited.
paragraphs.translation: 运动会那天，操场上站满了同学。比赛前我的心跳得很快。我们队排成一排，静静地等着。

paragraphs.text: The race started, and I ran as fast as I could. Then I passed the stick to the next runner. Our class got the second place at last.
paragraphs.translation: 比赛开始了，我拼命地往前跑。然后我把接力棒传给了下一位同学。我们班最后得了第二名。

paragraphs.text: I know that winning is not everything. Trying my best with my friends is the best prize. Now I never feel afraid of a big race.
paragraphs.translation: 我知道赢并不是一切。和朋友们一起努力，才是最好的奖励。现在我再也不怕大赛了。
